name: Trend day: pullback to VWAP holds → enter with the trend
why: On a trend day the programs benchmarked to VWAP keep buying (selling) at it, so a dip to VWAP that closes back on the trend side is that support holding. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_vwap_ema.md).

scan.when: abs(px - open) > m*atr && ((px > open && lo(5,1) <= vwap && cl(5,1) > vwap) || (px < open && hi(5,1) >= vwap && cl(5,1) < vwap))
scan.dir: (px > open && lo(5,1) <= vwap && cl(5,1) > vwap) - (px < open && hi(5,1) >= vwap && cl(5,1) < vwap)
